title: HyNote Review (2026)
intro: HyNote is evaluated here as AI software — HyNote is an AI note taker that turns meetings, audio, PDFs, YouTube, images (OCR), web pages, and phone calls into searchable notes with summaries, action items, and 30+ templates — without a meeting bot. Free includes recording/transcription (120 min/session), templates, sync, and calendar. Pro starts at $6.66/mo billed annually ($79.99/yr) with 1,200 transcription minutes/mo and transcript export. Plus ($10.83/mo annual) adds speaker ID and Notion/Google Docs transfer. Unlimited ($15.83/mo annual) adds unlimited real-time transcription and CRM. Teams is $15/seat/mo annual (min 2). Same ai-meeting cluster as Fireflies.ai and Otter.ai — multimodal capture and study/publish templates rather than bot auto-join or conversation intelligence depth. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s AI methodology (ease of use, AI job fit, output quality, workflow depth, integrations, governance/privacy, scalability, value, model capability), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose HyNote when multimodal AI notes (meetings, PDFs, YouTube) without a meeting bot are the job — not a general LLM or Fireflies-style conversation intelligence suite alone.
verdict: Choose HyNote when multimodal AI notes (meetings, PDFs, YouTube) without a meeting bot are the job — not a general LLM or Fireflies-style conversation intelligence suite alone. faq.question: Is HyNote AI meeting-notes software?
faq.answer: Yes. HyNote sits in the AI meeting / notes cluster with Fireflies.ai and Otter.ai. It is an AI note taker for meetings, audio, PDFs, YouTube, OCR, and web capture — not a general LLM assistant.

faq.question: How is HyNote priced?
faq.answer: Free forever with session recording/transcription. Pro starts at $6.66/mo billed annually ($79.99/yr). Plus is $10.83/mo annual, Unlimited $15.83/mo annual, and Teams $15/seat/mo annual (min 2). Pro/Plus/Unlimited include a 7-day free trial. Confirm live caps on hynote.ai/pricing.

faq.question: Does HyNote join Zoom, Meet, or Teams with a bot?
faq.answer: No. HyNote records from your device or accepts uploads — it does not publish a calendar auto-join bot like Fireflies. That is a fit win for bot-averse meetings and a gap if you need hands-free auto-join.

faq.question: What can HyNote capture besides live meetings?
faq.answer: Eight input types on first-party packaging: live audio, uploaded audio/video, PDFs, image OCR, YouTube/video links, web pages, phone calls, and Apple Watch. Summaries, action items, and 30+ templates sit on top of capture.

faq.question: Does HyNote have a free plan or free trial?
faq.answer: Yes — Free forever with no credit card for core recording/transcription (120 minutes per session). Pro, Plus, and Unlimited each publish a 7-day free trial. Confirm current terms with the vendor.

faq.question: When should I pick Fireflies or Otter instead?
faq.answer: Pick Fireflies.ai when calendar auto-join bots and Business conversation intelligence matter more than multimodal PDF/YouTube capture. Pick Otter.ai when you want a mature meeting auto-join notetaker with established workplace references. Pick HyNote when multimodal notes and a sub-$7 Pro floor matter more.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test HyNote?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage. Affiliate relationships never influence scores.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
HyNote is an AI note taker from Turing Intelligence LLC that turns meetings, audio, PDFs, YouTube links, images (OCR), web pages, and phone calls into searchable notes — without dropping a meeting bot into the call. Capture → abstractive summary → templates → export is the core loop: key points, action items, meeting minutes, study notes, and 30+ professional templates, with optional export to Google Docs, Notion, PDF, or TXT.

It competes in the same ai-meeting cluster as Fireflies.ai and Otter.ai, but the packaging bet is multimodal (eight input types) and bot-free recording rather than calendar auto-join or Business-grade conversation intelligence. Free forever covers recording/transcription with a 120-minute session cap; paid annual tiers start at Pro $6.66/mo ($79.99/yr).

sections.heading: Who it’s for
sections.body:
• Individuals and students who need multimodal notes (meetings + PDFs + YouTube) without a bot
• Buyers who want a free forever floor and a sub-$7 annual Pro entry
• Teams that prefer device recording / upload over auto-join bots
• Not ideal when calendar auto-join bots or Fireflies Business conversation intelligence are non-negotiable

sections.heading: Feature coverage
sections.body:
Meeting notes & transcription: supported — live or uploaded audio with speaker labels and timestamps on higher tiers; no meeting bot required.

Multimodal capture: eight input types (audio, upload, PDF, OCR, YouTube/video, web, phone, Apple Watch) funnel into one note workflow.

Summaries & templates: abstractive summaries, key points, action items, and 30+ templates (SWOT, interview, study, follow-up email).

Study & publish: quiz, flashcards, study plans, plus blog/slides/podcast/infographic outputs on paid credit packs.

Connectors: Google Docs and Notion transfer from Plus; calendar sync; CRM on Unlimited. Narrower Slack/CRM/API breadth than Fireflies.

Governance: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3, SOC 2 Type II infrastructure, GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA-aligned claims, plus Mac local transcription for a private offline path.

Not a general LLM, image studio, or coding assistant — meeting/document specialist models only.

sections.heading: Pricing
sections.body:
Verified 2026-08-28 from hynote.ai/pricing (annual-billed monthly equivalents unless noted):

• Free — $0 forever: recording & transcription, up to 120 minutes per session, templates, uploads, sync, calendar, private storage.
• Pro — $6.66/mo annual ($79.99/yr): 1,200 transcription minutes/mo, translation, transcript export. 7-day trial.
• Plus — $10.83/mo annual ($129.99/yr): real-time transcription quota, speaker ID, live translation, Docs/Notion transfer. 7-day trial.
• Unlimited — $15.83/mo annual ($189.99/yr, most popular): unlimited real-time transcription, unlimited storage, CRM. 7-day trial.
• Teams — $15/seat/mo annual ($180/seat/yr) from 2 seats: Unlimited features plus team templates, admin controls, priority support.

Confirm monthly toggle prices and live minute/credit caps before purchase. Affiliate economics excluded from scores.

sections.heading: How it compares
sections.body:
vs Fireflies.ai: HyNote wins on multimodal PDF/YouTube/OCR capture and a lower published Pro floor without a bot. Fireflies wins on calendar auto-join, unlimited transcription retention model, and Business conversation intelligence.

vs Otter.ai: HyNote wins when file/video multimodal capture and a sub-$7 Pro entry matter. Otter wins on mature meeting auto-join references and workplace notetaker familiarity.

vs Microsoft 365 Copilot: Copilot is a workspace LLM add-on with Teams recap — adjacent, not the same primary job as a standalone multimodal note taker.

sections.heading: Limitations
sections.body:
• No meeting bot auto-join — capture is device recording or file upload (polarising vs Fireflies bot UX)
• Conversation intelligence / team analytics depth is lighter than Fireflies Business
• Pro transcription minutes (1,200/mo) and session length (120 min) can cap heavy meeting days
• Teams admin/SSO depth needs confirmation versus enterprise meeting suites
• Younger brand vs Otter/Fireflies reference density
• Not a general LLM assistant or voice studio
